admission.justification: The retention test retries a reclaimed identity and counts runner calls; retaining this rule prevents duplicate model sessions after old attempt records are removed.

applicability: A retried presenter request whose attempt record was reclaimed, a repeated explainer Send, and an Update of a retired environment.
conditions: The presenter request identity outlives the attempt record it names.
The explainer ledger is read under the leaf lock before creating or attaching a seat, and message identity is derived from the leaf and request.
exclusions: A request the ledger no longer names is a new request.
A new first request after Retire can build another environment; a retired marker does not make every future Send forbidden.
statement: When the presenter's request ledger still names a reclaimed attempt, retrying that request refuses attempt-record-reclaimed and starts no second session. An explainer Send whose request ledger already records delivery returns the same seat and message identity without a second send or seat; a failed or pending delivery retries against that identity. An Update of a retired environment refuses explainer-retired.
